sections.title: Beloved: Personalizing the Brand

concepts: Prosperity includes the vitality of the human spirit
Energy, enthusiasm, and joy within companies

sections.description: Explains the two forms of prosperity and argues that connecting with customers and maintaining internal Energy and joy leads to financial resilience and a flourishing human culture, even in tough economic times.
sections.title: Prosperous: Financial and Human-Spirit Prosperity

summary: In this brief talk, Jeanne Bliss defines a 'beloved' brand as one that is discussed in personal terms rather than as a faceless company, and pairs that with 'prosperous' to describe both financial success and the prosperity of the human spirit within the organization. She anchors the idea with examples like Zappos and Custom Ink and argues that long-term profitability comes from deliberately connecting with customers and fostering Energy, enthusiasm, and joy inside the company. Prosperity, she asserts, is not only about money but also about the positive human experience generated by the brand, which makes engagements contagious and resilient even in difficult times such as the 2008 downturn.
title: Beloved and Prosperous: Building a Customer-Centric Brand That Is Financially Successful
topics: Joy and Energy within an organization
Zappos as a beloved brand example
Custom Ink as a beloved brand example
impact of the 2008 economic downturn on brand strategy
Connecting with customers as a growth strategy
